title: FIDS Boards Go Dark — Terminal Chaos

fields.sceneBrief: Crowded terminal concourse, passengers standing with rolling suitcases and phones, looking up at a row of blank, dark departure boards; some are shouting toward airline counters, others huddle in groups; high ceilings, late morning light through large windows, terminal signage visible but faded in the glare
fields.caption: Passengers panic as every FIDS screen goes dark. No flights, no gates, no info. The airport is silent but for the noise.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the FIDS has gone fully dark. The ops team must now initiate manual information dissemination via megaphones and whiteboards. Watch for any delay in calling for staff deployment.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: Ops announces via PA and deploys staff. Fire/EMS leads fire evacuations and assists access/functional needs. LEO secures the evacuated area and traffic control. Airlines/tenants evacuate leased areas.
